ms.report:
In this milestone, we successfully developed a comprehensive platform enabling the management and minting of NFTs. Our accomplishments include:
・Integration of tree planting data, building upon the foundations established in Milestone II PoA.
・Metadata standardization, involving cleaning, preparation, and formatting according to CIP-25 specifications, to facilitate on-demand NFT minting (as per Milestone III PoA).
・Deployment of a fully operational NFT minting function directly within the MTIDANO platform.
・Development of a user-friendly front-end interface, providing a streamlined experience for NFT minting, a marketplace overview of available NFTs, and a geographical map of tree planting locations. Check all here

Note: Please find the smart contract script here.
For a more in-depth understanding of these achievements, please see the close out report here including a short video.
